capabilities.title: Nexus routing reference for codegraph integration points
capabilities.sourceEvidence: codegraph: static call-graph + symbol index exported as JSON for agent query-time use
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The protected project route and reachable RECON panel are the actual integration surface; no detached route-reference module is treated as product proof.

capabilities.title: Pre-indexed call graph: function-level call relationships exported as queryable JSON
capabilities.sourceEvidence: codegraph core: parse source → emit call edges as JSON at index time
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Import/symbol graph via getProjectGraph; function-level call edges deferred.

capabilities.title: Protected graph and dependency-neighbor query API
capabilities.sourceEvidence: codegraph query API used by LLM agents to navigate large codebases without reading full files
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The protected project API returns import neighbors plus ownership, hotspot, and security context; full symbol definitions and usages remain deferred.

capabilities.title: Incremental re-index on file save to keep graph current during active development
capabilities.sourceEvidence: codegraph watcher mode: file-change events trigger partial re-parse
capabilities.reason: Nexus builds its bounded TypeScript and JavaScript import graph from current files on each protected query, so it has no persistent index that can become stale. A background watcher and database would duplicate that on-demand local contract.

capabilities.title: Federate call graphs across multiple repositories for polyrepo agent navigation
capabilities.sourceEvidence: codegraph multi-repo mode: merge indexes from multiple repos
capabilities.reason: The protected project graph is intentionally rooted to this Nexus checkout. Federating arbitrary repositories would require new path, retention, trust, and ownership boundaries outside the product's single-project context spine.
